bugs.title: OAuth callback errors are silently swallowed in UI
bugs.description: When OAuth returns `#error=...&error_description=...`, the router recognizes `error_description=` and calls `show('login')`, but never parses the error or displays it in `[data-auth-error]`. The user sees the plain login form with no feedback why OAuth failed.

bugs.title: Uncaught URIError in hash routing with malformed URI encoding
bugs.description: In js/app.js (line 1195): `const h = decodeURIComponent(rawHash.slice(1));` is executed without try-catch. When a malformed percentage-encoded hash like `#%E0%A4%A` is received, `decodeURIComponent` throws an unhandled `URIError: URI malformed`, completely breaking page navigation for subsequent hash changes.

bugs.title: OTP input maxlength='8' conflicts with 6-digit auto-submit
bugs.description: In index.html line 378: `<input class='field otp' id='auth-code' maxlength='8'>`. However, js/app.js line 1092 triggers `emailForm.requestSubmit()` as soon as `digits.length === 6`. If an 8-digit OTP is used or pasted, digits 7 and 8 are cut off by the instant auto-submit.
bugs.reproduction: Type 8 digits in #auth-code; form submits prematurely at 6th digit.

bugs.title: Memory leak in image scanner: URL.createObjectURL is never revoked
bugs.description: In js/app.js (line 923): `loadImage` calls `URL.createObjectURL(file)`, but `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` is never called anywhere in the codebase. Every scanned image (including 10MB-50MB mobile photos) remains resident in browser memory for the entire session.
bugs.reproduction: Scan multiple photos in succession; observe increasing blob memory allocations.

bugs.title: Absence of client-side file size guard for photo uploads (50+ MB risk)
bugs.description: In js/app.js (lines 953-958): `handleFile` directly calls `loadImage(file)` and attempts canvas downscaling on any image size without a pre-flight file size check (e.g. `if (file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024)`). On lower-end mobile devices, decoding high-resolution 50+ MB images can crash the browser tab (OOM).
bugs.reproduction: Upload a 50MB image; browser allocates canvas without size warning.

bugs.title: Uncaught TypeError when selecting pharmacy if Leaflet map fails to load
bugs.description: In js/app.js (line 844): In `selectPharm(i, fly = true)`: `ph.map.closePopup(); ph.map.once(...); ph.map.flyTo(...)` are executed without checking `if (ph.map)`. If Leaflet CDN is blocked, slow to load, or fails, clicking any pharmacy in the list throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'closePopup')`.
bugs.reproduction: Block https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js, navigate to #apteki, click any pharmacy in the list.

bugs.title: Leaflet map marker click misalignment under CSS body zoom: 1.25
bugs.description: In css/app.css: `:root[data-a11y='on'] body { zoom: 1.25; }`. In WebKit/Blink browsers, CSS `zoom` applied to a parent of a Leaflet map container disrupts Leaflet's internal `mouseEventToContainerPoint` calculations, causing click targets, marker hits, and popup positioning to be offset by 25%.
bugs.reproduction: Turn on A11y mode, open #apteki, click on map markers; note coordinate offset.
